title: Banco de Dados Resolutivo (BDR) / Resolutive Database Engine
description: BDR v0.1.0 is an experimental persistent key-value database Research Preview investigating deterministic resolutive addressing, local partitioning, adaptive structures, segmented write-ahead logging, atomic checkpoints, crash recovery, and reproducible benchmarking. This metadata describes the SOFTWARE release. The scientific preprint is a separate Zenodo publication with DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21937842 and CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 licensing.
